standard_changes: Require a new language/defaults version; this is an unreleased frozen candidate.
status: Own record only, never inherited or supplied by CSS/default rules.
no_value: Absence is not zero, empty text, false or auto. Null is a supplied null only on nullable properties.
containers: Child defaults apply when the container/role is present; materialization never manufactures semantic records.
file_identity: Only the declaring physical file owns a declaration name; includes retain that identity.

table.measurement: default font zero advance and computed line-height
table.over_100: Cap largest active group progressively until sum100; all leaders tie equally.
table.under_100_with_auto: Auto columns share remaining percentage equally.
table.constraints: Apply computed percentages first. If any minimum width cannot fit its share, indicator replaces table; do not silently steal percentage from another column.

shadow.bounds: Paint bounds expand; semantic geometry and hit areas do not.

decorations.list_cascade: A supplied list replaces the inherited list in source order.

surface_color.priority: Applies only at standard origin; explicit CSS, default rules and file values retain priority.
